## Specific task description

Task instruction: Click the top button of the blue alarm clock

Task description: The target is the blue alarm clock on the left side of the table. Press the light green raised button on top.

Success criteria: The gripper makes actual contact in the blue alarm clock’s top-button area, with the left gripper closed at the time of contact. Merely hovering above the button does not count as completion.

## Execution tips

- Use the closed left gripper's fingertips to contact the flat top of the button, choosing a point inside its boundary and away from the joint with the blue housing to avoid hitting the housing.
- Near the button, use small movements and touch gently along the normal to its top surface, reducing sideways contact. Adjust the pose where there is clearance above the button.
